excerptZh: 温哥华车库装修2026：基于6个真实项目，费用$15K–$75K+。ADU改造、结构重建、简单翻新。许可申请、预算规划，温哥华业主必读。
contentEn:
Garages in Vancouver do more than park cars. In a city where detached laneway houses are reshaping property values and strata rules are finally catching up to how people actually use their homes, the humble garage has become one of the most versatile renovation opportunities available.

Whether you are converting all or part of your garage into a workshop, a rental suite, a home gym, or a clean storage space, here is what Vancouver homeowners actually paid to do it in 2026.

What Does a Garage Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Costs vary more by scope than by city in Metro Vancouver. The same 400-square-foot garage in Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, or Surrey falls within roughly the same cost band for equivalent finishes. Here is the range based on six completed Reno Stars projects:

  • Cosmetic refresh (paint, flooring, lighting, new garage door): $15,000 – $25,000
  • Structural repair + upgrade (foundation, framing, electrical, new door): $25,000 – $45,000
  • Full conversion to ADU / laneway suite (plumbing, insulation, HVAC, permits, separate entrance): $50,000 – $75,000+

A garage renovation that involves an ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) conversion crosses into strata, municipal permitting, and sometimes BC Building Code compliance territory. Homeowners in Vancouver, North Vancouver, and West Vancouver have had the clearest ADU rules since the 2024 zoning updates, while Richmond and Surrey have more recently updated their secondary suite bylaws.

ADU Garage Conversions: What Is Actually Allowed in 2026

The biggest single factor driving garage renovation costs in Vancouver right now is whether you are converting to an ADU. A garage converted to a legal secondary suite can add $300–$500/month in rental income or serve as a mortgage helper suite. But the permitting path requires:

  • Confirmation your zone permits a secondary suite (most RS zones in Vancouver proper do)
  • A separate entrance, fire separation, and ceiling height compliance
  • Parking relaxation (Vancouver now allows reduced or zero parking for ADUs near frequent transit)
  • BC Building Code compliance for the separation between the suite and the main house

For Vancouver homeowners, the City of Vancouver's ADU centre at 515 Cambie handles pre-application consultations. North Vancouver and West Vancouver have similar but not identical rules. Reno Stars has completed garage-to-ADU conversions in Vancouver, Burnaby, and Richmond, navigating each municipality's slightly different permit queue and inspector expectations.

Structural Garage Renovation: When the Foundation or Framing Needs Work

Many garages in Vancouver were built in the 1950s through 1980s on concrete slabs that are now cracked, sloping, or not engineered to modern standards. If your renovation includes adding a second floor above the garage, or converting a carport to an enclosed garage, the structural work adds significant cost.

Concrete foundation repair and re-levelling for a 400-square-foot garage typically runs $8,000–$18,000 depending on whether the slab needs full replacement or just joint sealing and self-levelling. Header beam upgrades to support a floor above add another $4,000–$12,000 depending on the span.

Real Project Costs from Reno Stars in 2026

The following are actual closed-project costs for garage-related work completed or ongoing in Metro Vancouver in 2026:

  • Richmond whole-house renovation ($115,000–$120,000): included full garage interior clean-out, new drywall, lighting, and epoxy floor as part of a larger interior refresh. Garage portion estimated at $18,000–$22,000 of that total.
  • Vancouver WFH office glass partition conversion ($5,000–$8,000): garage-adjacent space converted to dedicated home office, demonstrating that a targeted garage renovation does not need to be a full structural project.
  • Burnaby townhouse renovation ($49,000–$51,000): exterior upgrades including new garage door and entrance cladding at the townhouse level.
  • Surrey whole-house renovation ($40,000–$45,000): full exterior refresh including garage door replacement and pot lights throughout, with no structural work required.

What Drives Garage Renovation Costs Up

  • Asbestos: Homes built before 1990 in Vancouver often have asbestos in garage insulation, floor tiles, or pipe wrap. Testing and certified abatement adds $2,000–$8,000 to the project budget.
  • Electrical upgrades: A basic garage renovation often needs a new 60-amp or 100-amp panel feed, new circuits, and EV charging rough-in. Electrician costs for garage work in 2026 run $3,000–$12,000 depending on scope.
  • Plumbing for ADU conversion: Running drain lines to a garage that was built without plumbing is one of the largest single line items, typically $8,000–$20,000 depending on distance from the main sewer stack.
  • Heating and insulation: Vancouver garages are often uninsulated. Bringing a garage to habitability for year-round use (especially as an ADU or home gym) requires exterior wall insulation, a garage heater, and potentially a mini-split system. Budget $5,000–$15,000 for this work.

How Long Does a Garage Renovation Take in Vancouver

A cosmetic-only garage refresh takes 1–3 weeks with a contractor on site. A structural renovation runs 6–10 weeks. An ADU conversion that requires separate permits from the City of Vancouver typically runs 12–20 weeks from first consultation to final inspection, though pre-application consultations can compress that timeline if you come prepared with a clear scope.

Do You Need a Permit for Garage Renovation in Vancouver?

Simple cosmetic work (painting, flooring, replacing a garage door) generally does not require a building permit in Vancouver or most of Metro Vancouver. Anything that changes the structure, adds electrical capacity, adds plumbing, or converts the garage use requires a permit. Changing the garage door itself is a separate permit from the building permit in most municipalities — budget an extra 2–4 weeks for the garage door permit if you are doing structural work simultaneously.

Vancouver's Active Building Permits page allows you to check current permit queue times by permit type. As of mid-2026, garage and ADU permits in Vancouver proper are running 6–10 weeks for first review.

Garage Renovation Budget Planning for Vancouver Homeowners

Before you finalize your budget, get a clear scope from a contractor that separates:

  1. What you must do (structural repairs, code compliance, asbestos abatement)
  2. What adds value (ADU conversion, EV charging, insulation upgrade)
  3. What you want to do (aesthetic finishes, custom storage, lighting design)

ADU conversions pencil out differently depending on whether you plan to rent the space. At $400–$500/month in rental income, a $60,000 ADU conversion pays back in 10–12 years. At current mortgage rates in BC, that is a comparable or better return to other renovation investments for homeowners who plan to hold the property.

Ready to Talk About Your Garage?

If you have a specific scope in mind, we can give you a budget range based on similar completed projects in your neighbourhood. Contact us for a free consultation.
contentZh:
温哥华的车库不仅仅是停车的地方。在这座城市，独立后院屋正在重塑房产价值，分契物业法规也在逐步适应人们的实际居住需求，普通车库已成为最具性价比的装修机会之一。

无论您是将车库改造成工作坊、出租套房、健身房，还是整洁的储藏室，以下是温哥华业主在2026年为此支付的真实费用。

2026年温哥华车库装修费用是多少？

大温地区的车库装修费用因项目范围而非城市而异。温哥华、本拿比、列治文或素里的400平方英尺车库，在相同装修标准下，费用大致在相近区间内。以下是基于Reno Stars完成的六个项目的实际费用：

  • 简单翻新（刷漆、地面、照明、新车库门）：$15,000 – $25,000
  • 结构修复+升级（地基、框架、电气、新门）：$25,000 – $45,000
  • ADU/后院套房整体改造（水管、隔热、HVAC、许可、独立入口）：$50,000 – $75,000+

涉及ADU（附属住宅单元）改造的车库装修，将进入分契物业、市政许可，有时还有BC省建筑法规合规领域。温哥华、北温哥华和西温哥华的业主自2024年区划更新以来拥有了最明确的ADU规则，而列治文和素里最近也更新了其次要套房附例。

ADU车库改造：2026年实际允许什么？

目前推动温哥华车库装修费用的最大单一因素是您是否在改造成ADU。改造为合法次要套房的车库每月可带来$300–$500的租金收入，或作为房贷助手套房。但许可申请路径需要：

  • 确认您的区域允许次要套房（温哥华市大部分RS区域允许）
  • 独立入口、防火分隔和净高合规
  • 停车减免（温哥华现在允许ADU在公共交通附近减少或免去停车位）
  • 套房与主屋之间的分隔需符合BC建筑法规

对于温哥华业主，温哥华市的ADU中心位于Cambie街515号，提供申请前咨询服务。北温哥华和西温哥华有类似但不完全相同的规则。Reno Stars已在温哥华、本拿比和列治文完成了车库转ADU的改造项目，并在每个市政当局略有不同的许可排队和检查员期望中进行了协调。

结构车库装修：地基或框架需要工程时

温哥华的许多车库建于1950年代至1980年代，混凝土板现在出现裂缝、倾斜或未按现代标准设计。如果您的装修包括在车库上方加建第二层，或将雨棚改造成封闭车库，结构工程将显著增加成本。

400平方英尺车库的混凝土基础修复和找平，通常费用为$8,000–$18,000（取决于板面是需要完全更换还是仅需接缝密封和自流平）。支撑上方楼层的横梁升级费用为$4,000–$12,000，取决于跨度。

Reno Stars 2026年真实项目费用

以下是2026年在大温地区完成或进行中的车库相关工程实际结算项目费用：

  • 列治文全屋装修（$115,000–$120,000）：包括车库内部全面清理、新干墙、照明和环氧地板，作为整体室内翻新的一部分。该部分费用估计为$18,000–$22,000。
  • 温哥华居家办公室玻璃隔断改造（$5,000–$8,000）：车库相邻空间改造为专用家庭办公室，说明有针对性的车库装修无需整体结构工程。
  • 本拿比城市屋装修（$49,000–$51,000）：外部升级包括新车库门和入口包层，属于城市屋级别。
  • 素里全屋装修（$40,000–$45,000）：全面外部翻新，包括车库门更换和全屋射灯，无需结构工程。

哪些因素会增加车库装修费用

  • 石棉：1990年前建造的温哥华房屋，车库隔热层、地砖或管道包裹中通常含有石棉。检测和认证清除费用为$2,000–$8,000。
  • 电气升级：基本车库装修通常需要新的60安或100安面板馈电、新电路和EV充电预埋。2026年车库电气工程费用为$3,000–$12,000，取决于工程范围。
  • ADU改造的管道工程：为原本无水管的车库铺设排水管线，是最大的单项费用之一，通常为$8,000–$20,000，取决于与主污水管的距离。
  • 供暖和隔热：温哥华车库通常无隔热。将车库改造为全年可用空间（尤其是作为ADU或家庭健身房）需要外墙隔热、车库加热器，可能还有分体式空调系统。预算$5,000–$15,000。

温哥华车库装修需要多长时间

纯简单翻新，车库现场施工需要1–3周。结构装修需要6–10周。需要单独许可的ADU改造，从首次咨询到最终验收通常需要12–20周，不过如果您带着明确的工程范围前来，预申请咨询可以缩短时间线。

温哥华车库装修需要许可吗？

纯简单工程（刷漆、地面、更换车库门）在温哥华或大温大部分地区通常不需要建筑许可。任何改变结构、增加电气容量、增加水管或改变车库用途的工程都需要许可。在大多数市政当局，更换车库门本身与建筑许可是分开的——如果您同时进行结构工程，请额外预留2–4周的车库门许可时间。

温哥华的Active Building Permits页面允许您按许可类型查看当前排队时间。截至2026年中，温哥华市的车库和ADU许可首次审核需要6–10周。

温哥华业主的车库装修预算规划

在确定预算之前，请从承包商处获得明确工程范围，分清：

  1. 必须做的（结构修复、法规合规、石棉清除）
  2. 增值项（ADU改造、EV充电、隔热升级）
  3. 想做的（美学饰面、定制储物、照明设计）

ADU改造的财务回报因您是否计划出租该空间而异。以每月$400–$500的租金收入计算，$60,000的ADU改造需要10–12年回本。按当前BC省的抵押贷款利率计算，对于计划持有该房产的业主来说，这比其他装修投资具有相当或更好的回报。

准备好谈谈您的车库了吗？

Reno Stars在2026年已在温哥华、本拿比、列治文和素里完成了车库转ADU改造、结构重建和简单翻新项目。如果您有具体的工程范围，我们可以根据您社区附近类似已完成项目给您一个预算范围。联系我们获取免费咨询。
